title: Checkout error 500 on mobile
snippet: Users report 500 errors when completing purchase on mobile devices.
full_text: When users attempt to complete a purchase on mobile devices (iOS/Android), they encounter a 500 Internal Server Error. The error typically occurs after entering payment information.
recommended_action: Escalate to payments team; reference incident INC-2023-09-10

title: Password reset email not received
snippet: Users report not receiving password reset emails.
full_text: Password reset emails are not being delivered to users' inboxes. Users can request the reset but never receive the email link.
recommended_action: Check email delivery provider logs; verify email service configuration; resend email

title: Slow page load times
full_text: The dashboard and reporting pages are experiencing slow load times, taking 10-30 seconds to render. This affects user experience significantly.
recommended_action: Check CDN status; review database query performance; analyze frontend bundle size

title: API rate limiting blocking legitimate requests
snippet: Customers hitting 429 errors on legitimate API requests.
full_text: Some customers are experiencing 429 Too Many Requests errors even with normal usage patterns. This suggests rate limit configuration may be too aggressive.
recommended_action: Review API rate limit settings; check for burst traffic; whitelist high-volume legitimate users

title: Missing fields in API response
snippet: API responses missing expected fields in certain conditions.
full_text: When querying specific endpoints with certain parameters, API responses are missing expected fields or returning null values unexpectedly.
recommended_action: Verify API schema version; check for recent deployments; ask for API endpoint and parameters used

title: Two-factor authentication not working
snippet: 2FA setup or authentication codes not working.
full_text: Users report that 2FA is not functioning: either setup fails or authentication codes are not accepted. May affect specific authenticator apps.
recommended_action: Check time sync on user device; verify authenticator app; test with different TOTP app; check server time drift

title: Billing issue: duplicate charges
snippet: Customers reporting duplicate charges on their account.
full_text: Several customers report being charged multiple times for a single transaction or subscription period.
recommended_action: Pull transaction logs; verify idempotency keys; escalate to finance team; prepare refund

title: Cannot export data to CSV
full_text: Users attempting to export data or reports to CSV format experience failures or receive empty/corrupted files.
recommended_action: Check disk space; verify export service logs; test with smaller datasets; ask for number of records being exported

title: Database connection timeout
snippet: Database operations timing out during peak hours.
full_text: Database connection timeouts occurring during business hours. Connection pool may be exhausted or network latency increased.
recommended_action: Check database server load; verify connection pool settings; review query performance; check network latency

title: Memory leak in background worker
snippet: Background worker process consuming increasing memory.
full_text: The background job worker process is consuming increasing amounts of memory over time, eventually causing restarts.
recommended_action: Profile application memory; check for unbounded caches; review job queue implementation; restart service

title: Notification emails not sending
full_text: System notifications and alert emails are not being sent to users. Affects alerts for security events and important updates.
recommended_action: Check email queue; verify email service configuration; review SMTP logs; resend notifications

title: Dashboard refresh not updating data
snippet: Dashboard shows stale data even after refresh.
full_text: When users refresh the dashboard, data does not update and shows stale information. Cache may not be invalidating correctly.
recommended_action: Clear browser cache; check cache invalidation logic; verify WebSocket connections; ask for specific metrics affected

title: How to integrate with third-party service
snippet: User asking how to set up integration with external service.
full_text: User needs guidance on integrating our platform with a third-party service or tool.
recommended_action: Provide integration documentation link; offer API key generation assistance; schedule integration walkthrough

title: Unable to delete account
full_text: Account deletion feature is not working or account cannot be fully removed from system.
recommended_action: Check account deletion workflow; verify no dependent resources; escalate to data team; confirm compliance

title: Configuration error in deployment
snippet: User asking about correct configuration for deployment.
full_text: User has questions about configuration options or settings for deploying in their environment.
recommended_action: Provide deployment documentation; share configuration template; offer setup consultation
